import pandas as pd

# Step 1: Define source file paths
source_files = [
    "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length6_98/training_0.csv",
    "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length6_98/training_1.csv",
    "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length6_98/training_2.csv",
    "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length6_98/training_3.csv",
    "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length6_98/training_4.csv",
    "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length6_98/training_5.csv",
    "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length6_98/training_6.csv"
]

# Step 2: Load all source tables into a list of DataFrames
# Each source has schema ['Id', 'SalePrice']
dfs = []
for i, file in enumerate(source_files):
    df = pd.read_csv(file, index_col=0)
    # Rename SalePrice column to reflect source index for joining later
    # According to target schema:
    # Source 0 -> SalePrice_x
    # Source 1 -> SalePrice_y
    # Source 2 -> SalePrice_x_3
    # Source 3 -> SalePrice_y_4
    # Source 4 -> SalePrice_x_5
    # Source 5 -> SalePrice_y_6
    # Source 6 -> SalePrice (final SalePrice column)
    if i == 0:
        df = df.rename(columns={"SalePrice": "SalePrice_x"})
    elif i == 1:
        df = df.rename(columns={"SalePrice": "SalePrice_y"})
    elif i == 2:
        df = df.rename(columns={"SalePrice": "SalePrice_x_3"})
    elif i == 3:
        df = df.rename(columns={"SalePrice": "SalePrice_y_4"})
    elif i == 4:
        df = df.rename(columns={"SalePrice": "SalePrice_x_5"})
    elif i == 5:
        df = df.rename(columns={"SalePrice": "SalePrice_y_6"})
    elif i == 6:
        df = df.rename(columns={"SalePrice": "SalePrice"})
    dfs.append(df)

# Step 3: Merge all dataframes on 'Id' using inner join to keep only Ids present in all sources
# This is because target examples have 729 tuples, fewer than any source (which have 730 or 1459 tuples),
# so intersection is needed.
merged_df = dfs[0]
for df in dfs[1:]:
    merged_df = pd.merge(merged_df, df, on="Id", how="inner")

# Step 4: Ensure column order matches target schema
target_columns = [
    "Id",
    "SalePrice_x",
    "SalePrice_y",
    "SalePrice_x_3",
    "SalePrice_y_4",
    "SalePrice_x_5",
    "SalePrice_y_6",
    "SalePrice"
]
merged_df = merged_df[target_columns]

# Step 5: Export the result to the target CSV file
output_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length6_98/target_multisource_cot.csv"
merged_df.to_csv(output_path, index=False)
